name: gap-provider-options
about: provider / model 配置键对发给 provider 的请求的影响（model/config/parseModelConfig.ts:110-124、parseModelDefinition:206-236、model/protocol/capabilities.ts）：apiKey 用 ${ENV} 从环境变量取、url 末尾斜杠、headers（含覆盖 User-Agent）、extraBody（嵌套对象、数值；基线里与 model / messages 同名的键会盖掉请求体本身，这里不测）、timeoutMs、模型 aliases 与 displayName、supportsParallelToolCalls、supportsStreaming=false（非流式请求）、supportsToolUse=false + supportsSystemPrompt=false。每轮用 modelOverride 选模型，最后用别名 nick 选一次，再看 model_catalog_list。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    custom:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/custom/v1/
      apiKey: ${BBX_GAP_KEY}
      timeoutMs: 30000
      headers:
        X-Bbx-Header: from-config
        User-Agent: bbx-agent/1.0
      extraBody:
        provider:
          order: [a, b]
        top_k: 7
        temperature: 0.25
      models:
        real-model-id:
          displayName: Real Model
          aliases: [nick]
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            supportsParallelToolCalls: true
            maxContextTokens: 32000
            maxOutputTokens: 1000
        nostream:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            supportsStreaming: false
            maxContextTokens: 32000
            maxOutputTokens: 1000
        nosystem:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: false
            supportsSystemPrompt: false
            maxContextTokens: 32000
            maxOutputTokens: 1000
telemetry:
  enabled: false
